menuItems.description: Spicy fried chicken slider tossed in a fiery house glaze with crunchy slaw and pickles on a toasted bun. Served with crispy tots that can handle the heat.

menuItems.name: Moonlit Herb Chicken Slider
menuItems.description: Roasted herb chicken slider with melted provolone, baby greens, and a lemony herb mayo on a soft bun. Served with rosemary-garlic fries for an elegant, spooky little side quest.

menuItems.name: Pumpkin Patch Veggie Slider
menuItems.description: Veggie burger slider with smoked gouda, crisp lettuce, tomato, and a tangy maple-mustard sauce on a toasted bun. Served with sweet potato fries for cozy autumn vibes.

menuItems.name: Velvet Fig & Prosciutto
menuItems.description: Prosciutto, fresh mozzarella, fig preserves, arugula, and a delicate balsamic glaze baked over crisp flatbread. Savory, silky, and beautifully balanced between sweet and salty with a lightly peppery finish. Served with a simple baby greens salad tossed in a light champagne vinaigrette to keep the pairing fresh and elegant.

menuItems.name: Midnight Truffle Mushroom
menuItems.description: A medley of roasted mushrooms, melted cheeses, and subtle truffle essence layered over golden flatbread. Earthy, aromatic, and quietly luxurious with deep savory warmth. Served with a crisp herb-dressed greens salad that brightens the richness and adds a refreshing contrast.

menuItems.name: Blushing Pear & Brie
menuItems.description: Creamy brie, ripe pear slices, toasted walnuts, and delicate honey baked until warm and luscious. Soft, lightly sweet, and indulgently smooth with gentle crunch. Served with a lightly dressed arugula salad whose peppery notes balance the silky cheese and fruit.

menuItems.name: Smokeshow Bacon & Caramelized Onion
menuItems.description: Smoked bacon, slow-cooked caramelized onions, melted cheese, and a subtle savory glaze over crisp flatbread. Rich, smoky, and deeply satisfying with irresistible brunch or late-evening appeal. Served with a bright mixed greens salad in a white wine vinaigrette to cut through the richness.

menuItems.name: Garden Pesto Chicken
menuItems.description: Tender roasted chicken, basil pesto, melted mozzarella, and roasted tomatoes baked over warm flatbread. Herbaceous, vibrant, and comfortingly savory with a lively, aromatic finish. Served with a refreshing cucumber and greens salad that complements the bright pesto and keeps the dish feeling light.

menuItems.name: Pride & Prejudice
menuItems.description: Black tea, bergamot peel, rose petals, subtle vanilla. A poised and balanced blend with gentle citrus brightness and soft floral undertones. Elegant at first impression, yet warmer and more layered as it lingers — much like Elizabeth and Darcy themselves.

menuItems.name: Sense & Sensibility
menuItems.description: Black tea, chamomile, soft lavender, honeyed notes. A graceful harmony of structure and softness. Smooth black tea grounds delicate florals, creating a refined yet tender cup that balances reason with quiet romance.

menuItems.name: Emma
menuItems.description: Green tea, peach pieces, elderflower, light citrus. Bright, charming, and beautifully composed. A lively green base with orchard sweetness and floral lift — confident, polished, and ever so slightly playful.

menuItems.name: Persuasion
menuItems.description: White tea, jasmine blossom, pear essence. Delicate and understated with quiet depth. Silken white tea unfolds gently, revealing soft florals and subtle fruit in a cup that rewards patience.

menuItems.name: Mansfield Park
menuItems.description: Assam black tea, clove, dried apple, warm spice. Composed, steady, and quietly complex. A structured black tea with restrained warmth and gentle spice — dignified, thoughtful, and enduring.

menuItems.name: Northanger Abbey
menuItems.description: Black tea, blood orange peel, hibiscus, soft berry notes. Vivid and spirited with a dramatic flourish. Bright citrus and jewel-toned fruit bring playful intrigue to a classic base — lively, imaginative, and delightfully bold.

menuItems.name: The Elizabeth Bennet
menuItems.description: A lively, lightly sparkling cocktail that balances sharp intelligence with unexpected softness. Ingredients: Earl Grey tea–infused gin, fresh lemon juice, honey syrup, orange bitters, topped with dry prosecco. Clever, refreshing, and just a little bit subversive—much like Elizabeth herself.

menuItems.name: The Emma Woodhouse
menuItems.description: Elegant, aromatic, and confidently composed—perhaps too confident. Ingredients: Jasmine green tea–infused vodka, elderflower liqueur, white peach purée, lemon juice, finished with a rose-petal garnish. Pretty, polished, and persuasive—this cocktail thinks it knows exactly what you want.

menuItems.name: The Anne Elliot
menuItems.description: A gentle, warming drink that rewards patience and quiet depth. Ingredients: Chamomile tea, aged rum, vanilla syrup, a touch of pear brandy, and a dash of nutmeg. Softly floral and comforting, with a slow-building richness—reserved at first sip, unforgettable by the last.

menuItems.name: The Elinor Dashwood
menuItems.description: Structured, balanced, and impeccably restrained—until you notice the emotional undercurrent. Ingredients: Black tea–infused bourbon, apricot liqueur, lemon peel, and a whisper of clove. Steady and sensible on the surface, with warmth and depth quietly revealed.

menuItems.name: The Lydia Bennet
menuItems.description: A lively, flirtatious soda with plenty of sparkle. Ingredients: Regency Breakfast black tea shaken with blood orange syrup, a splash of vanilla, and topped with sparkling water. Bright, bold, and a little impulsive — this one refuses to be ignored.

menuItems.name: The Mr. Knightley
menuItems.description: Grounded, refreshing, and impeccably balanced. Ingredients: Minted Moroccan Green Tea blended with fresh cucumber, lime juice, and soda water. Cool-headed and dependable, with a quiet depth beneath the freshness.

menuItems.name: The Marianne Dashwood
menuItems.description: Expressive, aromatic, and unapologetically romantic. Ingredients: Lavender Grey Cream tea infused with lemon, a touch of honey syrup, and sparkling water. Floral, emotional, and dramatic in the best possible way.

menuItems.name: The Catherine Morland
menuItems.description: Playful, bright, and delightfully imaginative. Ingredients: Rose & Lychee Blush green tea paired with raspberry syrup and soda water. Light, fruity, and charming — sweeter than expected, but never naïve.

menuItems.name: Regency Rose Reverie
menuItems.description: Vanilla sponge, rosewater, fresh raspberries, rose buttercream. A tender vanilla cake delicately scented with rosewater, crowned with soft rose buttercream and fresh raspberry brightness. Fragrant, romantic, and unmistakably elegant.

menuItems.name: Lavender Lace
menuItems.description: Lavender-infused sponge, vanilla bean, honey buttercream. Light vanilla cake gently infused with culinary lavender and finished with smooth honey buttercream. Softly floral, subtly sweet, and beautifully balanced.

menuItems.name: Elderflower Garden Party
menuItems.description: Lemon sponge, elderflower essence, whipped cream frosting. Bright lemon cake kissed with elderflower and topped with airy cream frosting. Fresh, luminous, and perfectly suited for afternoon celebration.

menuItems.name: Violet Velvet
menuItems.description: Vanilla cake, candied violet, delicate berry buttercream. Classic vanilla sponge layered with soft berry frosting and accented with candied violet notes. Graceful, lightly perfumed, and delightfully charming.

menuItems.name: Orange Blossom Sonata
menuItems.description: Orange-infused sponge, orange blossom water, citrus glaze. Tender citrus cake scented with orange blossom and finished with a glossy citrus glaze. Light, fragrant, and radiant with gentle sweetness.

menuItems.name: Chamomile Honey Heirloom
menuItems.description: Chamomile-infused vanilla sponge, wildflower honey, honey buttercream. A tender vanilla cake gently steeped with chamomile and sweetened with warm wildflower honey, finished with silky honey buttercream. Softly aromatic, delicately sweet, and quietly sophisticated — like a peaceful afternoon in the English countryside.

menuItems.name: The Darcy Reserve
menuItems.description: Buttered popcorn, aged white cheddar, cracked black pepper. Refined, bold, and quietly commanding. Sharp cheddar and peppery warmth create a savory blend that is confident without being ostentatious.

menuItems.name: Pemberley Herb Garden
menuItems.description: Buttered popcorn, rosemary, thyme, sea salt. Aromatic and elegant with delicate herbal notes. Light, fragrant, and perfectly suited to a civilized gathering.

menuItems.name: Colonel Brandon’s Truffle
menuItems.description: Buttered popcorn, subtle truffle essence, sea salt. Deep, earthy, and understatedly luxurious. A savory indulgence that speaks softly but leaves a lasting impression.

menuItems.name: Miss Bennet’s Toffee Delight
menuItems.description: Caramel-coated popcorn, toasted almonds, vanilla warmth. Golden, buttery, and delightfully crisp. Sweet caramel richness balanced with nutty depth for a charming confection.

menuItems.name: The Bath Assembly
menuItems.description: White chocolate drizzle, dried strawberry pieces, soft vanilla notes. Light, festive, and slightly flirtatious. Creamy sweetness with bright berry accents — perfect for celebration.

menuItems.name: Emma’s Orchard Glaze
menuItems.description: Apple-cinnamon glaze, gentle spice, light sugar finish. Warm, fragrant, and comfortingly sweet. A nod to autumn orchards and cozy English afternoons.

menuItems.name: Vanilla Bean Éclairs
menuItems.description: Light choux pastry filled with silky vanilla bean pastry cream and finished with a glossy fondant glaze. Classic, refined, and universally adored—an anchor pastry for any tea spread.

menuItems.name: Rose Pistachio Financiers
menuItems.description: Delicate almond tea cakes enriched with brown butter, studded with pistachio, and lightly perfumed with rose. Elegant, aromatic, and subtly luxurious without being overpowering.

menuItems.name: Lemon Madeleines
menuItems.description: Traditional shell-shaped sponge cakes with bright lemon zest and a soft, tender crumb. Light, uplifting, and ideal for pairing with black or floral teas.

menuItems.name: Chocolate Hazelnut Mille-Feuille Bites
menuItems.description: Crisp puff pastry layers filled with chocolate-hazelnut cream and finished with a delicate cocoa dusting. Decadent but restrained—rich flavor in an impeccably portioned form.

menuItems.name: Smoked Salmon & Dill Choux Puffs
menuItems.description: Light choux pastry filled with whipped cream cheese, smoked salmon, fresh dill, and lemon zest. Airy, elegant, and unmistakably celebratory.

menuItems.name: Caramelized Onion & Gruyère Palmiers
menuItems.description: Buttery puff pastry folded with slow-cooked onions and nutty Gruyère cheese, baked until crisp and golden. Savory-sweet, deeply aromatic, and endlessly snackable.

menuItems.name: Wild Mushroom & Thyme Vol-au-Vents
menuItems.description: Flaky pastry shells filled with sautéed wild mushrooms, shallot, and fresh thyme in a light cream sauce. Earthy, refined, and perfectly balanced for afternoon service.

menuItems.name: Prosciutto, Fig & Goat Cheese Croissants
menuItems.description: Mini croissants filled with tangy goat cheese, fig preserve, and thinly sliced prosciutto. Rich, salty-sweet, and unapologetically indulgent.

menuItems.name: Classic Cucumber & Herbed Cream Cheese
menuItems.description: Thin-sliced cucumber layered with whipped cream cheese, fresh dill, and chives on soft white bread, crusts removed. Cool, crisp, and timeless — the anchor of any tea spread.

menuItems.name: Smoked Chicken Salad with Tarragon
menuItems.description: Tender smoked chicken mixed with lemony mayonnaise, celery, and fresh tarragon on wheat bread. Savory, aromatic, and just hearty enough.

menuItems.name: Peppered Turkey & Whipped Brie
menuItems.description: Thin-sliced peppered turkey paired with lightly whipped brie and baby greens on soft white bread. Creamy and refined — a gentle alternative to heavier meats.

menuItems.name: Marinated Artichoke, Pesto & Baby Spinach
menuItems.description: Marinated artichoke hearts with fresh spinach and basil pesto on multigrain bread. Verdant, savory, and fully plant-based.

menuItems.name: The Garden Party Cup
menuItems.description: Rainbow carrots, cucumber spears, sugar snap peas, radishes, whipped herb yogurt dip. Fresh, crisp vegetables paired with a cool, airy herb yogurt. Bright, refreshing, and perfectly suited to a refined afternoon gathering.

menuItems.name: The Pemberley Green
menuItems.description: Blanched asparagus, broccolini, celery sticks, green beans, whipped feta with lemon zest. Tender green vegetables with creamy whipped feta for a savory, lightly tangy contrast. Elegant, balanced, and beautifully composed.

menuItems.name: The Harvest Rose
menuItems.description: Roasted golden beets, baby carrots, endive leaves, cucumber, honey–goat cheese dip. Earthy sweetness meets silky goat cheese with a gentle touch of honey. Rich, colorful, and delightfully autumnal.

menuItems.name: The Herb & Ivory Cup
menuItems.description: Cauliflower florets, jicama sticks, zucchini ribbons, cherry tomatoes, white bean & rosemary spread. Clean, lightly sweet vegetables paired with a smooth white bean dip infused with rosemary. Subtle, aromatic, and quietly sophisticated.

menuItems.name: The Midnight Market
menuItems.description: Purple carrots, red bell pepper strips, snap peas, cucumber, smoky roasted red pepper hummus. Bold colors and lively crunch paired with a deeply savory roasted pepper hummus. Vibrant, flavorful, and irresistibly snackable.

menuItems.name: The Regency Orchard Cup
menuItems.description: Cucumber ribbons, fennel slices, rainbow carrots, red endive leaves, whipped ricotta with dill. Crisp, lightly sweet vegetables paired with silky whipped ricotta brightened with fresh dill. Cool, refined, and beautifully balanced — delicate in flavor but striking in presentation.

menuItems.name: The Velvet Manor
menuItems.description: Aged white cheddar, prosciutto, green grapes, rosemary almonds, fig preserves, artisan crackers. Balanced and refined with savory depth and gentle sweetness. A timeless arrangement that feels polished and quietly luxurious.

menuItems.name: The Conservatory Selection
menuItems.description: Herbed goat cheese, marinated olives, roasted red peppers, cucumber slices, candied pecans, crostini. Fresh, vibrant, and slightly Mediterranean in spirit. Creamy, briny, and herbaceous with bright vegetable contrast.

menuItems.name: The Grand Assembly
menuItems.description: Sharp cheddar, salami, smoked almonds, cornichons, honey drizzle, crisp flatbread. Bold and structured with rich, savory notes and subtle sweetness. Confident flavors that linger pleasantly.

menuItems.name: The Orchard Parlour
menuItems.description: Brie, sliced pear, toasted walnuts, dried cranberries, honey, water crackers. Soft, creamy cheese balanced with fruit and crunch. Warm, gently sweet, and beautifully seasonal.

menuItems.name: The Nocturne Board
menuItems.description: Smoked gouda, soppressata, dark chocolate squares, blackberry preserves, sea-salt crackers. Deep, indulgent, and slightly dramatic. A luxurious combination of smoky, savory, and dark sweetness.

menuItems.name: The Ivory Drawing Room
menuItems.description: Triple cream cheese, roasted almonds, fresh berries, rosemary flatbread, apricot preserves. Light yet indulgent with creamy richness and bright fruit. Elegant, delicate, and effortlessly charming.

menuItems.name: Velvet Yuletide
menuItems.description: Black tea, vanilla bean, cocoa nibs, subtle cinnamon. A rich, smooth black tea layered with warm vanilla and a whisper of cocoa. Cozy, elegant, and perfectly suited for candlelit winter evenings.

menuItems.name: Sugarplum Soirée
menuItems.description: Black tea, plum pieces, soft spice, hint of citrus peel. Deep fruit notes with gentle holiday spice create a festive yet refined cup. Lush, jewel-toned, and delightfully celebratory.

menuItems.name: Mistletoe & Mulberry
menuItems.description: Green tea, mulberry, cranberry, light floral notes. Bright berries meet a smooth green base for a vibrant winter blend. Fresh, lightly tart, and beautifully balanced.

menuItems.name: Fireside Clementine
menuItems.description: Rooibos, clementine peel, clove, warm honey notes. Naturally caffeine-free with citrus brightness and gentle spice warmth. Comforting, aromatic, and wonderfully inviting.

menuItems.name: Winter Garland Earl Grey
menuItems.description: Black tea, bergamot, dried orange peel, cardamom. A festive twist on a classic. Bright citrus and soft spice add holiday depth to a structured, elegant base.

menuItems.name: The Gilded Cranberry Waltz
menuItems.description: Black tea, cranberry pieces, orange peel, cinnamon bark, delicate vanilla. A festive black tea layered with bright cranberry and warm orange, softened by gentle spice and a whisper of vanilla. Lively yet refined, it feels like a grand holiday evening — vibrant, elegant, and beautifully celebratory.

menuItems.name: The Holly Crown
menuItems.description: Gin, cranberry liqueur, fresh lime, rosemary syrup, sparkling wine. Bright cranberry and crisp gin lifted with bubbles and herbal rosemary warmth. Festive, lively, and beautifully balanced between tart and celebratory sparkle.

menuItems.name: Winter Heiress
menuItems.description: Vodka, white chocolate liqueur, peppermint essence, cream. Silky and indulgent with cool peppermint brightness. Smooth, luxurious, and perfectly suited to a glamorous holiday evening.

menuItems.name: The Gilded Fir
menuItems.description: Bourbon, maple syrup, orange bitters, smoked cinnamon garnish. Warm, deep, and quietly dramatic. Maple sweetness and subtle citrus lift bourbon into a rich, fireside-worthy cocktail.

menuItems.name: Velvet Snowfall
menuItems.description: Vanilla vodka, amaretto, cream, delicate nutmeg finish. Soft, nutty warmth layered with vanilla and a whisper of spice. Cozy, elegant, and gently decadent.

menuItems.name: The Crimson Sash
menuItems.description: Dark rum, pomegranate juice, fresh lime, spiced simple syrup. Bold jewel-toned fruit with warming spice and smooth rum depth. Lively yet grounded — festive without being overly sweet.

menuItems.name: Evergreen Reverie
menuItems.description: Tequila blanco, pear nectar, rosemary syrup, fresh citrus. Bright pear sweetness meets herbal evergreen notes for a fresh, modern winter cocktail. Clean, aromatic, and unexpectedly refined.

menuItems.name: Tinsel Fizz
menuItems.description: Cranberry syrup, orange zest, vanilla syrup, sparkling water. Bright cranberry and citrus sparkle with a soft vanilla finish. Lively, jewel-toned, and beautifully festive without being overly sweet.

menuItems.name: North Pole Nectar
menuItems.description: White peach syrup, coconut cream, sparkling water. Light orchard sweetness with creamy smoothness and effervescent lift. Soft, snowy, and delightfully refreshing.

menuItems.name: Scarlet Sleigh Ride
menuItems.description: Pomegranate syrup, raspberry syrup, splash of lime, sparkling water. Bold berry brightness with a tart citrus edge. Vibrant, playful, and perfectly dramatic for holiday gatherings.

menuItems.name: Frosted Sugarplum Sparkler
menuItems.description: Plum syrup, lemon-lime soda, hint of almond syrup. Deep fruit with a subtle nutty warmth and lively bubbles. Richly colored and irresistibly celebratory.

menuItems.name: Winter Orchard Pop
menuItems.description: Apple syrup, pear syrup, cinnamon essence, sparkling water. Crisp orchard fruit layered with gentle spice and sparkle. Cozy yet refreshing, like a holiday market in a glass.

menuItems.name: Emerald Garland
menuItems.description: Kiwi syrup, lime, splash of vanilla, sparkling water. Bright green and lightly tropical with smooth vanilla balance. Fresh, festive, and visually striking on the table.

menuItems.name: The Gingerbread Manor
menuItems.description: Dark chocolate, steamed milk, molasses, cinnamon, ginger, clove, whipped cream. Rich chocolate layered with warm molasses and festive spice for a true gingerbread embrace. Deep, cozy, and wonderfully nostalgic with a softly spiced finish.

menuItems.name: Velvet Peppermint Parlor
menuItems.description: Dark chocolate, steamed milk, peppermint essence, vanilla, whipped cream. Smooth, luxurious chocolate lifted with cool peppermint brightness. Elegant and refreshing while still decadently creamy.

menuItems.name: The Winter Heiress Cocoa
menuItems.description: Milk chocolate, cream, hazelnut essence, subtle sea salt. Silky and indulgent with gentle nutty warmth and a whisper of salt. Refined, comforting, and quietly glamorous.

menuItems.name: Yuletide Orchard
menuItems.description: Hot apple cider, cinnamon sticks, clove, orange peel. A classic winter warmer with bright citrus lift and cozy spice. Fragrant, nostalgic, and beautifully comforting on a cold evening.

menuItems.name: Pear & Partridge Hearth
menuItems.description: Hot pear cider, honey, cardamom, vanilla bean. Soft orchard sweetness layered with gentle spice and silky vanilla warmth. Elegant, lightly aromatic, and quietly luxurious.

menuItems.name: Garnet Glow Cider
menuItems.description: Pomegranate juice, apple cider, star anise, fresh ginger. Deep jewel-toned warmth with bright tart fruit and subtle spice. Lively yet comforting — festive, vibrant, and visually striking.

menuItems.name: The Hollycrest Shortbread
menuItems.description: European butter, vanilla bean, fine sugar, delicate sea salt. Tender, buttery shortbread with a whisper of vanilla and a soft, crumbly finish. Simple, elegant, and timelessly festive.

menuItems.name: Midnight Molasses Crinkles
menuItems.description: Dark molasses, ginger, cinnamon, clove, brown sugar. Deeply spiced and beautifully crackled on the outside with a soft, chewy center. Warm, aromatic, and perfectly wintery.

menuItems.name: Snowfall Almond Lace
menuItems.description: Sliced almonds, butter, caramelized sugar, light citrus zest. Thin, golden, and delicately crisp with nutty richness and a subtle citrus lift. Elegant and irresistibly delicate.

menuItems.name: Cranberry Noel Rounds
menuItems.description: Dried cranberries, white chocolate, vanilla dough. Soft vanilla cookies studded with tart cranberry and creamy white chocolate. Bright, cheerful, and beautifully balanced.

menuItems.name: The Evergreen Chocolate Thumbprint
menuItems.description: Chocolate dough, raspberry preserve, fine sugar. Rich chocolate cookies filled with jewel-toned raspberry. Deep, decadent, and visually striking on any holiday table.

menuItems.name: The Evergreen Bites
menuItems.description: Fresh mozzarella pearls, cherry tomatoes, basil leaves, balsamic glaze. Bright, fresh, and beautifully simple. Creamy mozzarella and juicy tomatoes with herbaceous basil create a festive red-and-green presentation that’s both elegant and refreshing.

menuItems.name: Winter Orchard Picks
menuItems.description: Pear cubes, brie bites, candied pecans. Soft, creamy, and lightly sweet with a satisfying crunch. A refined balance of fruit and cheese that feels both indulgent and celebratory.

menuItems.name: Holly & Honey Glaze
menuItems.description: Roasted chicken bites, rosemary sprigs, honey drizzle. Savory and aromatic with a gentle touch of sweetness. Tender chicken and fresh rosemary offer cozy winter warmth in an easy-to-enjoy skewer.

menuItems.name: Fireside Rosemary Bites
menuItems.description: Herb-roasted potatoes, smoked sausage slices, whole grain mustard glaze. Warm, savory, and deeply satisfying. Tender roasted potatoes paired with smoky sausage and a gentle mustard glaze create a cozy winter skewer with just the right touch of holiday richness.

menuItems.name: Gilded Fig & Prosciutto
menuItems.description: Fresh figs, prosciutto ribbons, honey. Silky, savory, and delicately sweet. A luxurious combination that feels effortlessly sophisticated and perfect for a holiday soirée.

menuItems.name: The Evergreen Whip
menuItems.description: Whipped goat cheese, fresh rosemary, honey, cracked black pepper, served with crostini and pear slices. Creamy, herbaceous, and lightly sweet with aromatic rosemary warmth. Crisp crostini and tender pear offer the perfect balance of crunch and softness.

menuItems.name: Cranberry Noel Spread
menuItems.description: Cream cheese, cranberry compote, orange zest, toasted pecans, served with water crackers and baguette slices. Bright, jewel-toned cranberry layered over smooth cream cheese with citrus lift and nutty crunch. Festive, slightly tangy, and beautifully holiday-forward.

menuItems.name: Winter Hearth Spinach Dip
menuItems.description: Spinach, garlic, cream cheese, Parmesan, cream, served warm with toasted sourdough cubes and baby carrots. Rich and velvety with savory depth and gentle garlic warmth. Comforting and indulgent without being heavy.

menuItems.name: Golden Onion Glow
menuItems.description: Caramelized onions, sour cream, thyme, sea salt, served with kettle chips and toasted flatbread. Deeply savory with sweet onion richness and herbal lift. A luxurious take on a classic, perfect beside winter cocktails.

menuItems.name: Yuletide White Bean Purée
menuItems.description: White beans, roasted garlic, olive oil, lemon zest, served with rosemary focaccia and cucumber spears. Silky and gently savory with bright citrus finish. Elegant, fresh, and beautifully balanced for lighter holiday grazing.

menuItems.name: Crimson Hearth Pairing
menuItems.description: Roasted tomato soup simmered with garlic, fresh thyme, and a touch of cream, served alongside a golden sourdough grilled cheese filled with sharp white cheddar and fresh basil. Bright, savory, and timelessly comforting with the perfect balance of richness and herbaceous lift.

menuItems.name: The Winter Orchard Pairing
menuItems.description: Silky butternut squash and apple soup infused with sage and vegetable broth, paired with rustic bread layered with nutty Gruyère and thin pear slices. Gently sweet, aromatic, and beautifully balanced between orchard warmth and creamy depth.

menuItems.name: Fireside Mushroom Pairing
menuItems.description: Velvety wild mushroom and shallot soup enriched with cream and fresh thyme, served with country bread grilled with fontina and caramelized onions. Deeply savory and indulgent, with luscious melted cheese complementing earthy winter flavors.

menuItems.name: Yuletide Chicken & Herb Pairing
menuItems.description: Roasted chicken soup with rosemary, garlic, and tender winter vegetables, accompanied by sourdough grilled with creamy Havarti and a light honey butter spread. Comforting and aromatic with a subtle festive sweetness.
